5 Manchester Experts Who Can Restore Your Furniture To Tip-Top Shape
 Claire Johnson | Last Updated: September 2025
Our criteria:
Table of Contents:

Have you ever sat on your favourite chair, heard a creak and then realised that the old lad probably needs some tender loving care? Okay, so maybe you don’t have a favourite chair, but it is a common issue for many budgeting homeowners! 

Now, there comes a time when furniture needs new life breathed, or rather, worked, into it. After all, you don’t always need to throw away a good piece of furniture at the smallest sign of wear and tear. Don’t even get us started on long-time family heirlooms!

Well, there may still be hope for your nan’s old chair (or any piece of furniture) that you can’t bear to part with. 

Luckily, Manchester’s got no shortage of craftsmen skilled enough to revitalise old or damaged furniture pieces. Our team sorted out the best ones by doing the legwork for you. Read on to see what we think about the best furniture restoration pros in the city!
